# Hair Transplant: Egypt or Turkey? | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/hair-transplant-egypt-or-turkey/
Language: en

> Egypt or Turkey for a hair transplant? What matters for Gulf patients: who operates, licence checks, what a quote includes, travel time and follow-up.

Hair Transplant· October 2026 · 8 min read
Hair transplant in Egypt or Turkey? A practical comparison for Gulf patients

Turkey is usually the first name Gulf patients hear when they start looking at hair transplants abroad, and Egypt is increasingly on the list too. The honest answer to "which is better?" is that the country matters far less than the clinic and the surgeon. This guide sets out how to compare the two like for like, so the decision rests on facts you can check rather than on advertising.

## The country matters less than who operates
Both countries have experienced surgeons, and both have high-volume clinics where most of the work is done by technicians while the surgeon supervises several patients at once. Neither model is hidden, but it is rarely explained in the advert.
Before comparing prices, ask each clinic in writing who will do each step on your day: who designs the hairline, who carries out the extraction, and who places the grafts. You should receive names, not job titles.

## How to check the licence in each country
- Egypt: ask for the surgeon’s full name and registration number with the Egyptian Medical Syndicate, and confirm the facility is licensed by the Ministry of Health and Population.
- Turkey: ask for the surgeon’s registration details and the facility’s Ministry of Health licence, including its authorisation to treat international patients.
- In both countries: a licensed surgeon will not mind the question. A clinic that avoids it is giving you an answer.

## Comparing quotes fairly
Advertised prices are hard to compare because packages are built differently. One quote may include the hotel, airport transfers, medication and aftercare products; another may include only the procedure.
A fair comparison needs the same three things from every clinic: a graft estimate made by the operating surgeon after reviewing your photos, a written list of what the price includes and excludes, and the cancellation terms. Without those, the cheaper quote is often not the cheaper trip.
For what drives the cost in Egypt specifically, see our guide to hair transplant costs and graft counts in Egypt.

## Travel time and length of stay
From most Saudi cities the flight to Cairo is shorter than the flight to Istanbul, which matters on the way home when your scalp is still healing and you want the journey to be simple.
In either country, most plans need a few days on the ground: a consultation, the procedure day and at least one check before you fly. The exact number of days is set by the surgeon, not by the package.

## Language, food and the trip around it
In Egypt you can speak Arabic with everyone from the surgeon to the driver, halal food is the default, and families often combine the trip with Cairo or a few days on the Red Sea once the surgeon allows it. In Turkey most Gulf patients rely on an interpreter provided by the clinic, which works but adds a step to every conversation about your care.

## Follow-up after you go home
Growth develops over months, so the most important question is who answers you at month three or month nine, and in which language. Ask for written aftercare instructions and a named contact before you travel, wherever you choose.

## A simple checklist for either country
- Surgeon’s full name and registration number
- Who does each step on the day, in writing
- Graft estimate from the operating surgeon, after reviewing your photos
- What the price includes and excludes
- How many days you need to stay
- Named aftercare contact and language
- Cancellation and refund terms

## Where Hayakkom fits
Hayakkom coordinates treatment in Egypt only; we do not arrange treatment in Turkey. If you are considering Egypt, we put your photos to a licensed Egyptian surgeon, send you their written estimate and the surgeon’s details, and arrange your stay and transfers. Hayakkom does not perform procedures and does not guarantee results. More about hair transplant coordination in Egypt.

# How Long to Stay in Egypt for Treatment | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/how-long-stay-egypt-medical-treatment/
Language: en

> Realistic stay lengths for the treatments Gulf patients most often travel to Egypt for, and what actually determines them.

Planning· October 2026 · 7 min read
How long should you stay in Egypt for medical treatment? A guide by procedure

Booking a return ticket before you know how long you will take to recover is the most common and most expensive mistake in medical travel. Change fees, extra hotel nights, or worse — flying before you are fit — all trace back to the same error. This guide gives realistic stay lengths for the treatments Gulf patients most often travel to Egypt for, and explains what actually determines them.

## The short answer, by treatment
Hair transplant: 4–6 days. Procedure day, first wash, follow-up check, then fly.Veneers or Hollywood smile: 5–7 days across 2–3 clinic sessions.Dental implants: two separate trips of 3–5 days each, several months apart, unless you are a candidate for immediate loading.Full-arch All-on-4: 7–10 days.Bariatric surgery (sleeve or bypass): 7–10 days, including 1–2 nights in hospital.Rhinoplasty: 7–14 days.Liposuction or body contouring: 7–10 days.Abdominoplasty: 10–14 days.Breast surgery: 8–12 days.
All of the above are planning ranges. Your treating doctor fixes the actual duration based on how you recover.

## What actually determines your stay
Four things, roughly in order of importance.
Recovery and fitness to fly. This is the governing constraint for any surgical procedure. Immobility on a plane raises clot risk, and you want to be near your surgeon if a complication appears in the first week.
Number of appointments. Veneers need several fitting sessions. Implants need integration time between placement and crown. That cannot be compressed by paying more.
Whether tests are done locally or on arrival. If you can complete blood work and imaging at home before you travel, you usually save two or three days.
Whether complications occur. Nobody plans for this, but a prudent itinerary leaves margin rather than booking the earliest theoretically possible flight.

## Build the trip backwards from the final check
The practical planning method: identify the final review appointment at which your doctor confirms you are fit to travel, then book your return at least a full day after it.
That single habit removes most of the stress from medical travel. It means a delayed appointment or slower-than-expected recovery does not turn into a missed flight.
For surgical procedures we generally advise adding two days of margin above the clinical minimum. For non-surgical treatment, one day is usually enough.

## What you can usually complete before travelling
This is the biggest time saving available. Depending on the procedure, the following can often be done at home and sent ahead:
Routine blood work and laboratory tests. Existing imaging — X-ray, CT, MRI, dental radiographs. Your medical history and current medication list. Photographs for hair transplant or cosmetic assessment. Records of any previous surgery.
Sending these in advance lets the treating doctor review your case, give you a provisional pathway and estimate, and tell you what remains to be done on arrival. It also means you find out before buying tickets if you are not a suitable candidate.

## If you are travelling with family
Gulf patients often travel with a spouse, children or a parent. That changes planning in two useful ways.
First, your companions do not need to sit in the hospital for the whole stay. Where the recovery period allows, and only with the doctor’s agreement, there is room for light family activity while you rest.
Second, accommodation matters more. A lift, quiet rooms, room service so you do not have to go out to eat, and proximity to the clinic become practical necessities rather than preferences.
We coordinate both sides — the medical schedule and the family logistics — so they do not collide.

# Medical Tourism in Egypt: A Guide for Gulf Patients
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/medical-tourism-egypt-gulf/
Language: en

> Everything Saudi, UAE and Kuwaiti patients need to know about arranging medical treatment in Egypt — costs, hospitals, process and what to expect.

Medical Tourism· October 2026 · 8 min read
Medical Tourism in Egypt for Gulf Patients — Complete 2026 Guide

Egypt has quietly become one of the most important medical tourism destinations in the Arab world — particularly for patients from Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Kuwait. With internationally trained specialists, modern private hospitals and costs 40–70% lower than the Gulf, it is easy to see why thousands of Gulf patients choose Egypt every year.

## Why do Gulf patients choose Egypt for medical treatment?
Egypt’s leading private hospitals — among them As-Salam International, Dar Al Fouad and Alameda Healthcare — offer internationally accredited facilities staffed by specialists trained in the UK, the United States, Europe and the region’s best universities.
Beyond clinical quality, cultural and linguistic familiarity make Egypt a natural choice. Gulf patients communicate easily, the food is familiar, the climate is mild, and the country offers world-class sites for recovery and rest.

## Which medical services are available?
Specialist consultations · surgical procedures · dental treatment · dental implants · veneers and cosmetic dentistry · oncology consultations · orthopaedic procedures · ophthalmology · fertility consultations · dermatology · cardiology consultations · second medical opinions.
Note: Hayakkom coordinates access to licensed medical providers. We do not provide medical services directly and cannot guarantee specific medical outcomes.

1. Contact us by WhatsApp or the enquiry form with your medical need2. We match you to the right specialist or hospital3. We arrange the consultation appointment4. We coordinate travel, accommodation and airport transfers5. We support you during your stay — interpreting, transport, follow-up6. We help coordinate post-treatment care where needed

## What should I prepare before travelling to Egypt for treatment?
Medical records and reports from your local doctor. Recent test and imaging results (X-ray, MRI, blood work). A list of current medications. Travel insurance covering medical treatment abroad. Emergency contacts.
Contact Hayakkom at least two weeks before your planned travel for the smoothest coordination.

# Nile Cruise Luxor to Aswan: Itinerary | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/nile-cruise-planning-guide/
Language: en

> A day-by-day Nile cruise itinerary between Luxor and Aswan: 3, 4 or 7 nights, which temples you visit, the best months to sail and practical tips for Gulf families.

Nile Cruises· October 2026 · 8 min read
Nile cruise from Luxor to Aswan: itinerary, duration and the best time to sail

A Nile cruise between Luxor and Aswan is one of the world’s great journeys: temples, green riverbanks and villages that seem outside time, seen from the deck of a boat. This guide explains the usual routes and durations, what a typical day-by-day itinerary looks like, when to go, and how to choose a boat that suits a Gulf family.

## Which direction, and how many nights?
- Luxor to Aswan: usually 4 nights, sailing upstream with time at each stop.
- Aswan to Luxor: usually 3 nights, the same sites in a shorter programme.
- Round trip: usually 7 nights, starting and ending in Luxor.
Exact days and the order of visits vary from boat to boat, so always check the programme of the specific sailing you book.

## A typical itinerary: Luxor to Aswan in 4 nights
- Day 1, Luxor: board the boat; visit Karnak Temple and Luxor Temple.
- Day 2, West Bank of Luxor: the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Hatshepsut and the Colossi of Memnon; sail south through the Esna lock.
- Day 3, Edfu and Kom Ombo: the Temple of Horus at Edfu, then the riverside temple of Kom Ombo in the late afternoon.
- Day 4, Aswan: the High Dam, Philae Temple and a felucca sail around the islands; an optional early trip to Abu Simbel.
- Day 5: breakfast on board and disembark in Aswan.

## When is the best time to go?
October to April is the most comfortable season, with warm days and cool evenings. In summer, temperatures in Luxor and Aswan regularly pass 40°C, so visits start very early in the morning and the middle of the day is spent on board. Winter is also the busiest season, so book early for school holidays.

## Choosing a boat
- Booked through a licensed Egyptian tour operator
- Cabins with a large window or balcony; connecting or family cabins if travelling with children
- A shaded sun deck and a pool for the hot months
- Halal food, which is standard on Egyptian boats
- Guided visits available in Arabic

## Getting to Luxor or Aswan
Most guests fly from Cairo to Luxor or Aswan, about an hour in the air. There is also an overnight sleeper train from Cairo for those who prefer it.

## Combining a cruise with a medical trip
Many Gulf patients add a cruise to a treatment trip. Ask your treating doctor before booking: after some procedures you need rest, or should avoid strong sun, heat or swimming for a while, and the cruise should come after that period rather than during it.

## Practical tips
- Pack light: cabin storage is limited on smaller boats
- Bring sun protection; the light on the river is intense
- Tickets for Tutankhamun’s tomb in the Valley of the Kings are sold separately
- Carry some cash for tips and small purchases at the stops

## Where Hayakkom fits
Hayakkom arranges Nile cruises through licensed Egyptian tour operators, around your treatment dates or your family holiday. More about Nile cruises with Hayakkom.

Want your case reviewed before you decide?
Send your reports and we will come back to you in writing, with no obligation. Contact us

# Physiotherapy Sessions in Egypt | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/physiotherapy-sessions-egypt/
Language: en

> Planning physiotherapy in Egypt from the Gulf: who decides the number of sessions, what to send before you travel, and how long to stay.

Physiotherapy· October 2026 · 7 min read
Physiotherapy sessions in Egypt: how many you need and how long to stay

More Gulf families are asking about physiotherapy and rehabilitation in Egypt, often after an operation, an injury or a long illness, and often as part of a longer family stay. The first questions are always the same: how many sessions, and how long do we need to stay? This guide explains who answers those questions and how to plan the trip around them.

## Who decides how many sessions you need
The number of sessions is set by the licensed physiotherapist after assessing you, working from your own doctor’s referral and reports. It is not something a coordinator, a package or an advert can decide in advance, and you should be wary of anyone who quotes a fixed number before you have been assessed.
Many programmes run over several weeks with a few sessions each week, but your plan may be shorter or longer. Ask the centre for the proposed schedule in writing after the first assessment.

## What to send before you travel
- Your doctor’s referral or latest medical report
- Recent imaging reports, if you have them
- The operation report, if the physiotherapy follows surgery
- A list of the medicines you take
- Your mobility needs: wheelchair, walking aid, lift access, accessible bathroom
With these, a licensed centre can tell you before you book whether it can see you and roughly how long it expects the programme to last.

## How long to plan your stay
Because the programme is confirmed only after the first assessment, plan your accommodation by the week rather than booking a fixed number of nights. Leave room for the assessment day at the start, for rest days, and for a final review before you fly home.

## Choosing where to stay
The right place is close to the centre, with lift access or a ground floor, an accessible bathroom and short, comfortable transfers. Serviced apartments often suit families better than hotels on longer stays, because everyone has space and a kitchen.

## Combining it with a family trip
Sessions usually take part of the day, which leaves time for the family. Cairo has plenty to do within a short drive, and Ain Sokhna on the Red Sea is about two hours away by road for a weekend, if the physiotherapist agrees.

## Continuing at home
Before you leave, ask the centre for a written report and a home programme you can give to your doctor or physiotherapist in Saudi Arabia, so the progress you made continues after you return.

## Questions to ask the centre
- Is the centre licensed, and who will treat me?
- Will I see the same physiotherapist each time?
- How long is each session?
- Can we speak in Arabic?
- Will I receive the plan and the cost in writing?

## Where Hayakkom fits
Hayakkom coordinates; licensed providers treat. We put your referral to a licensed physiotherapy centre, send you its written schedule and cost, and arrange accommodation and daily transfers around your sessions. We do not assess, diagnose or treat. More about physiotherapy coordination in Egypt.

Want your case reviewed before you decide?
Send your reports and we will come back to you in writing, with no obligation. Contact us

# The Pre-Travel Case Review Explained | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/pre-travel-consultation/
Language: en

> What you send for a case review before travelling to Egypt, how long it takes, what you receive — and what it does not include.

Before You Travel· October 2026 · 7 min read
The pre-travel case review: what to send, and what you get back, before you book

The most expensive mistake in medical travel is booking the ticket first and asking the detailed questions afterwards. A pre-travel case review reverses the order: you find out whether travelling makes sense at all, and how much time and money it will take, before you spend anything on flights.

## What is a pre-travel case review?
It is an administrative review of your medical file before you travel. You send us what you have — reports and imaging — we put it to the appropriate hospital or clinic in our network, and we come back to you with what the provider said: whether the case is suitable for treatment in Egypt, how many sessions or visits they expect, and how long you would need to stay.
The aim is not to persuade you to travel. In some cases the conclusion is that travelling is not worthwhile — either because the treatment is available closer to you at a similar cost, or because the case needs long-term follow-up that does not suit a short trip. Knowing that before booking is a gain, not a loss.

## What to send
The clearer the file, the more accurate and faster the answer. What we usually need:
• Recent medical reports from your current doctor — PDF or clear photographs• Imaging and tests: CT and panoramic scans in DICOM format where possible, not a phone photo of a screen• A list of current medications and doses• History of allergies, chronic conditions and previous operations• A copy of your passport for visa arrangements and bookings• The dates that suit you, and how much leave you have available
A practical note: original DICOM files are read far more quickly than phone photographs. If your imaging is on a disc or a hospital link, send the link as it is.

## How long does the review take?
We confirm receipt of your file within one working day and tell you if anything is missing. The technical response from the hospital or clinic usually takes 2–5 working days, and may take longer if the doctor needs an additional test or a second specialist opinion.
If your case is urgent, say so in your first message — some cases are prioritised.

## What you receive at the end
A written response, not a verbal call that gets forgotten. It includes:
• The provider’s view on whether the case suits treatment with them• The expected number of visits or trips — this point changes the budget entirely• An estimated stay length for each trip• A written estimate of our administrative and coordination costs• Which tests you should complete before travelling, to save time here
A point often missed: some treatments — dental implants being the clearest example — need two separate trips months apart, not one. Anyone comparing prices on a single-trip basis arrives at an unrealistic figure. You can estimate the difference yourself with the trip cost calculator.

## What this review does not include
We repeat this point because it protects both sides:
• Hayakkom is a coordination and logistics company. It does not diagnose, prescribe treatment or offer a medical opinion• Diagnosis and the treatment plan come from the licensed treating physician, not from us• A pre-travel review is not a substitute for clinical examination — the final plan is set after direct assessment• Written estimates are estimates, and change if the case changes after examination
Any coordinator who gives you a final diagnosis over WhatsApp before a doctor has seen you has overstepped. That is one of the criteria discussed in how to choose a coordination company.

## What happens to your data?
Your medical file is shared only with the provider concerned with your case, and only with your consent. Your data is not published, not used in marketing and not shown to third parties. You can request deletion of your file at any time.

## Common questions
Is the review binding? No. Most people who have a case reviewed do not end up travelling, and that is normal.
Do I need a visa before the review? No. The review comes before any travel arrangement.
Can someone travel with me? Yes, and tell us early — it changes accommodation and transfer arrangements.
What if my reports are old? Send them as they are; the doctor may ask for some tests to be updated, and these can often be done in your own country before travelling.

Want your case reviewed before you decide?
Send your reports and we will come back to you in writing, with no obligation. Contact us

Information in this article is for general educational purposes. It is not medical advice. Hayakkom is a coordination company and does not provide medical services directly.

# 12 Questions Before Choosing a Clinic Abroad | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/questions-before-choosing-clinic-abroad/
Language: en

> The checklist we would want a member of our own family to use, including the awkward questions and what a good answer actually sounds like.

Patient Safety· October 2026 · 10 min read
12 questions to ask before choosing a clinic abroad — and what a good answer sounds like

Most bad medical travel experiences are not caused by bad surgeons. They are caused by questions nobody asked. This is the list we would want a member of our own family to use — including the awkward ones, and what a good answer actually sounds like. Use it on us exactly as you would on anyone else.

## 1. Who specifically will perform my procedure?
You want a name, a specialty, and their specific training in the procedure you need — not "our team of experts".
A good answer names the doctor and describes their qualifications and exact specialty. A weak answer keeps the surgeon anonymous until you arrive. If you cannot find out who will operate on you before you travel, that is information in itself.

## 2. Is this doctor licensed, and can I verify it?
Licensing is verifiable in most countries. A provider should be willing to give you the doctor’s registration details so you can check independently.
Be wary of vague claims of international training without specifics. "Trained in Europe" is not a qualification; a named certificate from a named institution is.

## 3. Where will the procedure actually take place?
The clinic where you consult is not always the facility where you are treated. Ask for the name and address of the actual operating location, and whether it is licensed for that procedure.
For surgery under general anaesthesia, ask specifically about on-site emergency and intensive care capability.

## 4. Is the facility accredited, and by whom?
Accreditation claims should always come with a body, a scope and a current status. "Internationally accredited" on its own means nothing.
If a provider cannot name the accrediting body, treat the claim as undocumented. We apply this to ourselves: we will not publish an accreditation for a partner facility without documentation.

## 5. What exactly does the quoted price include?
Ask for it itemised: doctor’s fees, facility fees, anaesthesia, tests, implants or materials, medication, follow-up appointments, and accommodation and transfers if they are part of the package.
Then ask the most revealing question: what does it not include?

## 6. What could add to the cost, and how likely is that?
Common additions include bone grafting in dental work, a second session in hair transplant, revision procedures, extended hospital stay, and treatment of complications.
A provider who raises these before you ask is showing you how they operate. One who says there are never any additional costs is either inexperienced or not being straight with you.

## 7. Is this a final price or an estimate?
For almost any procedure requiring clinical assessment, the honest answer before examination is "an estimate".
A fixed final price from photographs alone — especially for dental implants or any surgery — is a warning sign, not a service. One Cairo dental clinic states in its patient guide that no serious implant clinic should quote finally before assessing bone volume by imaging. That is the correct standard.

## 8. What happens if a complication occurs?
Ask specifically: who is responsible, what does it cost, and what happens if it appears after I return home?
You want to know whether corrective treatment is covered, who to call outside working hours, and how coordination with a doctor in your own country would work. The answer matters more than the likelihood.

## 9. How long will I actually need to stay?
Not how long the procedure takes — how long until I am cleared to fly. Those are very different numbers.
Anyone offering you surgery with a three-day total trip is not planning for your recovery. Flying too soon after an operation carries real clot risk.

## 10. What follow-up happens after I return home?
Ask what happens in the weeks after you fly. Is there a scheduled review? Will you get a written summary of what was done, a medication list and instructions? Can you reach the treating doctor with a question?
A provider whose involvement ends at the airport is offering you a transaction, not care.

## 11. How is my medical information handled?
You will be sending scans, reports and possibly photographs. Ask who receives them, how they are stored, how long they are kept, and whether they are shared outside the treating provider.
You are entitled to a clear answer, and entitled to refuse the use of your case or images in marketing.

## 12. What is your relationship with the clinic you recommend?
This is the question people most hesitate to ask a coordinator, and the most reasonable one to ask.
Ask whether the recommendation is based on your clinical need or a commercial arrangement, and whether alternatives were considered. You are entitled to know how a provider was chosen for you.
Our position: we coordinate with independent licensed providers, we verify licensing before listing anyone, and we will tell you why a particular provider suits your case. We do not provide treatment and we do not guarantee clinical outcomes.

Want your case reviewed before you decide?
Send your reports and we will come back to you in writing, with no obligation. Contact us

Information in this article is for general educational purposes. It is not medical advice. Hayakkom is a coordination company and does not provide medical services directly.

# Does Saudi Insurance Cover Egypt Care? | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/blog/saudi-insurance-treatment-egypt/
Language: en

> How the unified cooperative policy works, when treatment abroad might be covered, and what documents you need to make a claim.

Insurance & Costs· October 2026 · 8 min read
Does my Saudi health insurance cover treatment in Egypt?

The short answer is usually no — but not always, and the detail is worth ten minutes of your time before you pay. This article explains how to check your own policy rather than relying on guesswork.

## How health insurance works in Saudi Arabia
Cooperative health insurance in the Kingdom is built on a unified policy overseen by the Council of Cooperative Health Insurance, and it is designed primarily to treat you inside the Kingdom and through your insurer’s approved provider network.
That is the heart of the matter: the policy assumes you are treated at a hospital inside the network, and that the bill goes directly from the hospital to the insurer. Treatment at a hospital outside the Kingdom sits outside that arrangement by default.

## When might treatment abroad be covered?
There are genuine cases where it happens, and all of them require checking in advance:
International coverage policies: some corporate plans and higher-tier policies include cover outside the Kingdom, sometimes within defined geographic limits.
Medical referral: where the treatment is not available inside the Kingdom and the case is referred through official channels.
Emergencies while travelling: an entirely different cover, concerning what happens to you suddenly while abroad — not treatment you planned in advance.
The condition that sinks most claims: prior approval. Even where overseas cover exists in your policy, it usually requires the insurer’s approval before treatment. Anyone treated first and claiming afterwards is usually refused — not because the treatment was uncovered, but because the order was wrong.

## What is usually not covered
Regardless of where treatment takes place, insurance policies normally exclude purely elective and cosmetic procedures. That means a large share of what people travel for — cosmetic dentistry, hair transplant, elective cosmetic surgery — is not covered in your own country either, let alone abroad.
Procedures with medical indications — bariatric surgery under defined conditions, for example — may be covered inside the Kingdom within set limits and conditions. Which makes the real question: are you better treated inside the Kingdom with cover, or outside it at your own expense? There is no single answer.

## Questions to put to your insurer — copy these as they are
Call your insurer’s customer service (Bupa Arabia, Tawuniya, MedGulf or another) and ask for the answers in writing:
• Does my policy include any cover for treatment outside the Kingdom, and what is its geographic scope?• Is the specific procedure I need covered at all inside the Kingdom?• Do you require prior approval? What documents are needed and how long does assessment take?• If I pay myself abroad, is there any route to partial reimbursement, and at what rate?• What is the statutory period for submitting a claim after the treatment date?• Do you require translated or certified invoices?
Ask for the reply by email or through the app, not by phone. A written answer is what helps you later if you disagree.

## If you decide to pay yourself — what to collect
Even if you are unsure about cover, collect the documents while you are still here. Obtaining them after you return is far harder:
• An itemised, stamped invoice from the hospital or clinic — not a lump-sum payment receipt• The medical report setting out the diagnosis and the procedure performed• Prescriptions and pharmacy invoices, separately• Proof of payment — card receipt or transfer• Certified translation if your insurer requires it
Our guide on how long to stay in Egypt for treatment helps you work out when the final report will be ready before you fly.

## Where does Hayakkom stand in all this?
Plainly: Hayakkom does not deal with insurance companies and does not bill them directly. We are a coordination and logistics company, and payment is made by you directly to the medical provider.
What we do is make sure you leave with a complete file: an itemised invoice, a medical report and organised documents, so that if you decide to submit a claim your paperwork is ready. Whether the claim is accepted or refused is your insurer’s decision alone, and we make no promises about it.
This article is informational and is not insurance or legal advice. The terms of your own policy are what govern, and they differ from policy to policy and year to year.

## A practical conclusion
Assume you will pay out of pocket, and plan your budget on that basis — then treat any reimbursement as a bonus if it materialises. That order protects you from the worst outcome: building your decision on cover you never confirmed.
To estimate the real cost before any commitment, use the trip cost calculator — it accounts for multiple trips, accommodation and transfers, not just the procedure price.

Want your case reviewed before you decide?
Send your reports and we will come back to you in writing, with no obligation. Contact us

Information in this article is for general educational purposes. It is not medical advice. Hayakkom is a coordination company and does not provide medical services directly.

# Investment & Business Tourism Egypt | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/business/
Language: en

> Corporate tours and real estate facilitation for Gulf investors in Egypt.

Business Services
Business, Conferences, Medical Marketing & Investment
Four registered business lines for organisations: medical conferences and events, marketing for healthcare providers, investment and corporate tourism, and educational programmes.

## 1 — Medical conferences & events
Full organisation of medical conferences, symposia, CME events, healthcare exhibitions and corporate medical seminars in Egypt. We handle venue sourcing and negotiation, delegate registration, speaker and faculty logistics, audio-visual and staging, simultaneous Arabic/English interpretation, catering, delegate transfers and accommodation blocks, and on-site coordination. Egypt offers conference venues in Cairo, the New Administrative Capital, Sharm El Sheikh and Hurghada at a fraction of European or Gulf costs, with strong GCC air connectivity. This is an activity expressly registered under our Commercial Register No. 49973.

## 2 — Marketing for healthcare providers
Administrative and marketing consultancy for hospitals, clinics and medical centres seeking Gulf patients. Services include GCC market positioning, Arabic-first digital marketing, patient-journey and enquiry-handling design, international-patient department setup advisory, content and campaign production, and referral coordination from Gulf markets. We advise on how to present a facility credibly to Saudi, UAE and Kuwaiti patients — we do not make medical claims on a provider's behalf, and all published credentials must be verifiable.

## 3 — Investment & corporate tourism
Real estate investment tours · Factory and industrial site visits · Business networking facilitation · Executive travel coordination · Trade mission logistics · Corporate group travel. Investment areas commonly requested: the New Administrative Capital, North Coast real estate, Red Sea resort developments, industrial zones and tourism-sector assets. Hayakkom coordinates access, logistics and introductions. We are not a real estate broker, financial adviser or investment intermediary, and we do not practise brokerage activity.

## 4 — Educational & professional programmes
University and campus visits · Arabic language programmes · Medical and archaeological study tours · Professional development and training visits · School and institutional group travel · Delegation hosting. Suitable for academic institutions, training departments, medical associations and student groups travelling from the Gulf.

Business engagements start with a scoping call rather than a form. Tell us the objective, the approximate dates, the number of people involved and your budget range, and we will come back with a written scope and an itemised estimate. For conferences we normally need 8–12 weeks' notice; for marketing engagements we work on monthly retainers or defined projects.

Medical Trip Cost Calculator

Most people planning treatment in Egypt know the price of the procedure and not the cost of the trip. This adds what usually gets left out: flights from your city, accommodation, transfers, and the number of trips — dental implants need two, which doubles flights and hotels.

 Treatment
 Number of teeth
 Flying from
 Accommodation
 Nights per trip
 CompanionTravelling aloneOne companion

 These are indicative ranges for planning only. Hayakkom does not set treatment prices — the treating provider does, and confirms the cost after clinical assessment. Flight and hotel rates vary by season and booking date.

## Why dental implants need two trips

The implant is placed on the first trip. The bone then needs time to heal around it — commonly two to six months depending on the case — and the crown is fitted on the second trip. Anyone budgeting for a single trip is planning for roughly half the real cost.

Immediate-loading options allow a temporary bridge on the same day, but the final restoration is fitted after healing. Which approach suits you is a decision for the treating dentist.

- Dental treatment in Egypt — costs and stay

Hayakkom is a medical coordination company registered in Egypt, Commercial Register 49973. It is not a healthcare provider. Figures on this page are indicative ranges compiled from published market data, not quotations.

Questions

## Dental treatment in Egypt — common questions

### How much do dental implants cost in Egypt?
Published market prices in Egypt run from roughly EGP 7,000 to 42,000 per implant. That is third-party market data, not a quotation from us. The widest variable is the implant system used, then the crown type, then whether bone grafting is needed. Your own cost is confirmed by the treating provider after reviewing your imaging.

### Is the crown included in the implant price?
Usually not. The crown is typically priced separately in Egyptian clinics, and this is what catches most patients out. Always ask whether a quoted figure covers implant and crown together, or the implant alone.

### How many trips do I need for dental implants?
Implants normally require two trips, months apart. The first places the implant (3-5 days), the bone then needs time to heal around it, and a second trip fits the crown (3-5 days). Immediate loading is not suitable for every case and is a decision your dentist makes after examination and imaging.

### What imaging do I need before travelling?
A panoramic X-ray usually, and for implant cases a CBCT scan. Recent images from your dentist at home are often enough for an initial review, and save you time and cost after arrival.

### Can I get a price before I travel?
A preliminary estimate, yes. You send imaging and reports, a licensed provider reviews them, and you receive an indicative plan, cost estimate and expected length of stay before booking a flight. The final figure is confirmed after direct examination.

### What is the difference between Korean, German and Swiss implants?
The implant system's country of origin is the biggest driver of price. Which suits you is a clinical decision your dentist makes based on bone condition and treatment plan. But you are entitled to know which system will be used and what it costs, in writing, before you travel.

### When is bone grafting or a sinus lift needed?
When bone density or height is insufficient to hold the implant securely. This is determined from CT imaging and adds to both cost and duration - which is why a final price cannot be given from a photograph.

### Can I fly straight after the procedure?
For most dental work yes, but the decision belongs to the treating dentist. We schedule your return after the provider confirms you are fit to travel.

### Who follows up after I return home?
We coordinate follow-up between you and the treating provider. Make sure you leave with a written report including the implant system used - your dentist at home will need it for any future work on that tooth.

### Why do prices differ so much between Egyptian clinics?
The implant system, crown material (zirconia, E-max or porcelain), the dentist's experience, the facility standard, and whether preparatory work such as bone grafting is required.

> Rhinoplasty, liposuction, tummy tuck and breast surgery in Egypt coordinated for Gulf patients — surgeon selection

Cosmetic Surgery
Cosmetic & Plastic Surgery in Egypt
Rhinoplasty, body contouring, liposuction and breast surgery coordinated with licensed Egyptian plastic surgeons — with realistic recovery planning built in.

Indicative costs

## Procedures coordinated
- Rhinoplasty and revision rhinoplasty
- Liposuction, VASER and high-definition body contouring
- Abdominoplasty (tummy tuck)
- Breast augmentation, reduction and lift
- Gynecomastia (male breast reduction)
- Blepharoplasty (eyelid surgery)
- Facelift and facial rejuvenation
- Post-bariatric body contouring
- Fat transfer procedures

## Recovery time is the part people underestimate
Most cosmetic surgery requires 7–14 days in Egypt before you are cleared to fly — this allows initial recovery, follow-up appointments and safe flight clearance. Tummy tucks typically need 10–14 days. Flying too early after surgery carries genuine risk, including of blood clots. Anyone offering you a 3-day cosmetic surgery trip is not planning your recovery properly.

## What Hayakkom coordinates
- Surgeon selection matched to your specific procedure
- Pre-travel photo and medical history review by the surgeon
- Pre-operative investigations
- Operating theatre and hospital scheduling
- Recovery-appropriate accommodationlift access, quiet rooms, room service
- Airport and clinic transfers in a comfortable vehicle
- Arabic-speaking accompaniment to appointments
- Post-operative check appointments before departure
- Flight-clearance confirmation from the surgeon
- Follow-up coordination after you return

## Discretion
We understand many patients prefer this handled privately. Your enquiry, documents and itinerary are handled by a single named coordinator, and nothing is shared beyond the treating provider without your consent.

## Honest expectations and risks
Every surgical procedure carries risk — bleeding, infection, scarring, asymmetry, reaction to anaesthesia, and the possibility of a result that differs from what you pictured. Revision procedures cost more than primary ones. Suitability is assessed clinically: the surgeon may recommend a different procedure than the one you asked for, or advise against surgery. Healthy patients with realistic expectations are the appropriate candidates. Hayakkom does not guarantee any aesthetic outcome — that judgement belongs to your surgeon, and no honest surgeon guarantees an exact result either.

# Dental Treatment in Egypt: Costs & Stay | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/dental/
Language: en

> Implants, veneers and full-mouth work in Cairo for Gulf patients. Indicative prices, how long each treatment takes, and why implants need two trips.

Dental Tourism
Dental Treatment in Egypt
Premium dental care at 50-70% less than Gulf prices — implants, veneers, Hollywood smile, all coordinated with Egypt's finest clinics.

Indicative costs

### What to expect

Dental Implant
per implant

Typical range in Egypt
940 SAR – 2,300 SAR
Full observed range: 560 SAR – 3,300 SAR
Suggested stay: 2 visits, 3–5 days each

Implant brand is the biggest cost factor — Korean systems are lowest, Swiss (Straumann) highest. The crown is often priced separately.

Porcelain Veneer
per tooth

Typical range in Egypt
340 SAR – 680 SAR
Full observed range: 230 SAR – 1,100 SAR
Suggested stay: 5–7 days

Composite veneers cost less than porcelain but last less. Per-tooth price usually drops on a full set.

Full Smile Makeover (Hollywood Smile)
full set, 16–20 teeth

Typical range in Egypt
6,800 SAR – 12,000 SAR
Full observed range: 3,800 SAR – 15,000 SAR
Suggested stay: 7–10 days

Usually covers all visible teeth. Final count is decided by the treating dentist after examination.

All-on-4 Full Jaw Implants
per jaw

Typical range in Egypt
8,300 SAR – 11,300 SAR
Full observed range: 5,900 SAR – 16,600 SAR
Suggested stay: 7–10 days

Immediate-loading options allow a temporary bridge the same day. Final prosthesis is fitted after healing.

Estimated — not a final price

# Full Body Check-up in Egypt | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/full-checkup/
Language: en

> Book a full body check-up at a licensed Egyptian hospital or check-up centre, with accommodation, transfers and an Arabic-speaking coordinator.

Full Check-up
Full Body Health Check-up in Egypt for Gulf Visitors
A comprehensive check-up booked at a licensed Egyptian hospital or diagnostic centre, combined with your accommodation, transfers and a written report.

## How it works
Tell us your age, your own doctor's advice if you have any, and the dates you plan to travel. We ask licensed hospitals and diagnostic centres which check-up packages they offer and send you their written offers, with what each includes and the price, so you can compare before you decide.

## How much does a full body check-up cost?
The price depends on the hospital and on what each package includes. We send you the providers' written offers, with the price and contents of each package, before you book. We do not publish estimated prices.

## What we coordinate
- Booking at a licensed hospital or diagnostic centre
- Preparation instructions from the provider, such as fasting, sent to you before your visit
- Accommodation close to the hospital
- Transfers on the day
- An Arabic-speaking coordinator at your side
- Collection of your reports, with a copy sent to your own doctor if you ask
- Follow-up appointments where the provider recommends them

## Combine it with your trip
Most check-ups are completed within a day or two, so many guests add a Nile cruise, a Cairo itinerary or a coastal stay for the family. We arrange the check-up first and the leisure programme around it.

## Your results
Results are explained to you by the provider's physicians. Hayakkom does not interpret results or recommend treatment; if the provider advises further tests or treatment, that is a decision between you and your doctor.

## An important boundary
The check-up is carried out entirely by an independent licensed Egyptian hospital or centre. Hayakkom is a coordination company and not a medical provider. The contents and price of each package are set and confirmed in writing by the provider.

# Hair Transplant in Egypt: Cost & Recovery | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/hair-transplant/
Language: en

> FUE and DHI hair restoration in Egypt for Gulf patients, for men and women. Indicative costs, how many days you need, and what to expect after you return home.

Hair Restoration
Hair Transplant in Egypt (FUE / DHI)
FUE, DHI and sapphire technique hair restoration coordinated with licensed Egyptian surgeons — for Gulf patients who want a natural hairline without Gulf pricing.

Indicative costs

### What to expect

Hair Transplant (FUE / DHI)
per session

Typical range in Egypt
4,500 SAR – 11,300 SAR
Full observed range: 3,800 SAR – 31,900 SAR
Suggested stay: 4–6 days

Price is driven mainly by graft count and technique. FUT is lowest, FUE mid-range, DHI higher, robotic (ARTAS) highest.

Estimated — not a final price
The figures above are publicly published market data from Egyptian clinics and platforms — they are not a Hayakkom quote. Prices vary widely by technique, materials and surgeon experience. Your actual price is confirmed after clinical review.
All final medical decisions, including whether a procedure is appropriate for you, rest with the licensed treating physician. Hayakkom coordinates; it does not provide medical services and does not guarantee outcomes.

Get My Estimated CostSpeak to a Coordinator
Where these figures come from: Ranges compiled from publicly published price lists of Egyptian clinics and hospitals and from clinic-quote aggregators, reviewed 2026-09-15. This is third-party market data, not a Hayakkom quotation.Reviewed 2026-09-15

## Techniques available
- FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction)minimally invasive, no linear scar, the most widely used method
- DHI (Direct Hair Implantation) for precise angle and density control
- Sapphire FUE
- FUT, suitable for very large areas
- PRP support therapy alongside transplantation

## What actually determines your price
Two things dominate: the number of grafts you need, and the technique used. Graft count is decided by the surgeon after examining your donor area and the extent of loss — it cannot be quoted accurately from a photo. FUT is the lowest-cost technique, FUE mid-range, DHI higher, and robotic systems the highest.

## What Hayakkom coordinates
- Surgeon and clinic selection based on your case
- Pre-travel photo review and graft estimate from the clinic
- Appointment scheduling
- Airport transfers
- Hotel near the clinic
- Arabic-speaking accompaniment on the day
- Post-procedure washing appointments before you fly
- Follow-up coordination after you return home

## Typical timeline
Day 1 — consultation, donor assessment, graft planning. Day 2 — procedure (6–8 hours depending on graft count). Day 3 — first wash and aftercare briefing. Days 4–5 — rest, follow-up check, then fly home. Visible regrowth typically begins at 3–4 months, with fuller results at 8–12 months.

## Honest expectations
A transplant redistributes your existing hair — it does not create new follicles. Density achievable depends on your donor area. Results develop over months, not weeks. Some patients need a second session for full coverage. Any clinic promising a guaranteed density or an exact final look before examining you should be treated with caution. Final graft count, technique and expected outcome are decided by the treating surgeon.

# How to Choose a Medical Coordinator in Egypt | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/how-to-choose/
Language: en

> Eight criteria you can verify yourself before trusting any company with your medical records or your money: registration, pre-travel review

How to Choose a Medical Coordinator in Egypt | Hayakkom

How to choose a medical coordinator in Egypt: 8 criteria you can verify

We will not tell you we are the best — that is not a judgement we can issue about ourselves, and you should not accept it from anyone. What follows is eight practical criteria you can measure any company against, including us. Under each one we have stated our own position plainly, including the criterion we do not meet.

## 1. Is the company registered? Ask for the commercial register number
The easiest question and the first one. A registered company has a verifiable register number, an address and legal liability. An individual operating through Instagram has none of that — and if they disappear tomorrow there is nobody to pursue.
Hayakkom: Egyptian Commercial Register 49973, under Law 159 of 1981, Sheikh Zayed City, Giza.

## 2. Will they review your medical records before you book a flight?
This is the most important item on the list. If you travel and then discover you are not a suitable candidate, or that your case needs a different plan, you have paid for flights and accommodation for nothing. Pre-travel review is the difference between an organised trip and a gamble.
Hayakkom: we collect your reports and imaging and put them to a licensed provider before you book, so you receive a provisional plan, a cost estimate and an expected length of stay.

## 3. Will they name the treating doctor and licence before you travel?
You have a right to know who will treat you. A company that withholds the doctor's name until you arrive is hiding the one thing you could verify yourself — Egyptian physicians are registered with the Medical Syndicate and that registration can be checked.
Hayakkom: the patient is told the doctor's name and qualifications before booking a ticket. Weight-loss cases are coordinated with Dr Ahmed Shabana, consultant in laparoscopic and bariatric surgery, under written authorisation.

## 4. Do you get a written treatment plan and cost estimate?
Verbal quotes are not enforceable. A written estimate protects you from surprise increases, and it is the only thing that makes comparing two companies possible at all.
Hayakkom: the plan and estimate are issued in writing by the treating provider before travel. Hayakkom does not set treatment prices — the provider does.

## 5. Who receives your money, and under what agreement?
Ask plainly: do I pay the company or the clinic? And who is responsible if the service is not delivered? Transferring a large sum to a personal account with no contract is the single most common feature of the complaints you read about.
Hayakkom: the provider sets and collects its own fees; Hayakkom charges a declared coordination fee. In Saudi Arabia a Saudi partner handles management and collection under a written agreement.

## 6. What happens after you return home?
Most companies end their relationship with you at the airport. But follow-up after you return is what actually determines whether the treatment succeeded — particularly for dental implants and bariatric surgery.
Hayakkom: we coordinate follow-up with the provider after you return. We also advise leaving Egypt with a written report and the details of what was used in your treatment — implant type and lot number — because your doctor at home will need them.

## 7. Are they licensed as a tour operator? And do they need to be?
People overlook this one. Arranging flights, hotels and tours is a tourism activity regulated by Egypt's Tourism Companies Law No. 38 of 1977, and it requires a Ministry of Tourism licence. A company selling you a complete trip without one is operating outside the law.
Hayakkom: we are not a licensed tourism company and do not claim to be. Travel, accommodation and transfers are arranged through licensed Egyptian operators who contract with you and invoice you directly.

## 8. Does their advertising comply with Egyptian law?
An unexpected but accurate signal. Law 206 of 2017 and Supreme Council for Media Regulation Decision 9 of 2025 prohibit describing methods of diagnosis or treatment in advertising, and require the licence number to be displayed. A company that explains surgical techniques in its adverts is breaking the law — and if it will cross that line, what else?
Hayakkom: we audited the entire platform against both and removed every description of treatment method. The commercial register appears on every page.

## Common questions

### Is Hayakkom the best medical coordination company in Egypt?
We cannot answer that, and you should not accept an answer from any company. What we can offer is criteria you verify yourself: registration, pre-travel records review, disclosure of the treating doctor, a written estimate, a clear payment route, follow-up after you return, and regulatory compliance. Measure any company against those eight, including us.

### What does Hayakkom not do?
Hayakkom is not a hospital, clinic or healthcare provider, and does not diagnose or treat. It is not a licensed tourism company. It does not give visa advice. It does not set treatment prices. It does not guarantee medical outcomes. These limits are stated because a company that does not state its limits is the one that should worry you.

### How do I verify a doctor's licence myself?
Ask for the doctor's full name and their registration number with the Egyptian Medical Syndicate, and check the facility with the Ministry of Health and Population. This is your right, and a licensed doctor will not mind the question. A company that withholds those details is telling you something important.

### What is the most common mistake patients make?
Booking a flight before the records are reviewed. The correct order: gather your reports, put them to a licensed provider, get a written plan and estimate, then book flights around the medical schedule rather than before it.

### What are the warning signs of a company to avoid?
A final price from a photograph with no examination. A guaranteed medical result. Withholding the provider's name or licence. Asking you to travel before your case is reviewed. Patient testimonials that cannot be verified. A personal account for transfers with no contract. And detailed descriptions of surgical techniques in advertising, which is a breach of Egyptian law.

URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/medical/
Language: en

> Coordinating specialist consultations, hospital bookings and procedures for Saudi, UAE and Kuwaiti patients in Egypt.

Medical Tourism
Medical Tourism in Egypt
World-class healthcare coordination for Gulf patients — licensed doctors, top hospitals, full logistics from the Gulf to Egypt.

## What we coordinate
We help Gulf patients access Egypt's leading hospitals and specialist clinics — from initial consultation booking through to post-treatment follow-up. We handle every coordination so you focus on your health.

## Services included
- Specialist consultations
- Medical procedures
- Hospital bookings
- Airport & clinic transfers
- Accommodation
- Translation
- Caretaker services
- Follow-up coordination

## Our medical partners
We work with Egypt's most trusted private hospitals: As-Salam International Hospital, Dar El Fouad, and Alameda Healthcare — all internationally accredited with bilingual staff.

## Why Egypt for medical treatment?
Egypt offers internationally trained specialists, modern private facilities, and costs commonly 40-70% lower than Gulf countries.

## How it works
1. Contact us with your medical need → 2. We match you with the right specialist → 3. Consultation is arranged → 4. We coordinate travel & stay → 5. Full support throughout treatment & recovery

# Nile Cruise Luxor to Aswan: Itinerary & Booking | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/nile-cruise/
Language: en

> Nile cruise itineraries between Luxor and Aswan for Gulf families, arranged around your plans and booked through licensed Egyptian operators.

Nile Cruises
Nile Cruise from Luxor to Aswan
Sail through ancient history on a luxury Nile cruise — from Cairo feluccas to multi-day Luxor-Aswan voyages.

## Cruise options
- Felucca sunset sailing (Cairo)
- Day cruise (Luxor or Aswan)
- Luxor to Aswan 3-4 night cruise
- Aswan to Luxor 3-4 night cruise
- Luxury 5-7 night cruise with all sites

## What to expect
- Karnak & Luxor Temples
- Valley of the Kings
- Edfu & Horus Temple
- Kom Ombo
- Philae Temple
- Nubian villages
- All meals, guided excursions, and on-board entertainment included

## Best time to cruise
October to April: ideal temperatures (20-28°C). May to September: very hot but cruises still run. Christmas and Easter are busiest — book in advance.

Accommodation & Transfers

## Where you stay, and how you get around
Accommodation chosen for recovery rather than for star rating, and every transfer with a professional driver. Booked through licensed Egyptian operators; Hayakkom coordinates them and does not operate them.
Recovery Stay

### Recovery Accommodation — Studio
Price on request
A serviced studio for one patient, or a patient travelling with one companion. Chosen for recovery rather than for star rating, within a short transfer of your treating clinic.
- ✓ Approx. 55–70 m², one bathroom
- ✓ Lift access on every property
- ✓ Air conditioning and a kitchenette
- ✓ Room service, so meals need not mean going out
- ✓ New Cairo · Sheikh Zayed · Maadi · Downtown
- ✓ Short transfer to your clinic for review appointments

Family

### Recovery Accommodation — Two Bedroom
Price on request
For a patient travelling with family. Separate sleeping space matters after surgery — the patient rests while companions come and go.
- ✓ Approx. 110–130 m², two bedrooms
- ✓ Lift access and a quiet floor where available
- ✓ Full kitchen for dietary requirements
- ✓ Space for a companion or attending nurse
- ✓ New Cairo · Sheikh Zayed · Maadi · Downtown
- ✓ Transfers to appointments included in coordination

Extended Family

### Recovery Accommodation — Three Bedroom
Price on request
For longer stays and larger families, or where two patients travel together. Suited to treatments needing seven days or more.
- ✓ Approx. 160–180 m², three bedrooms
- ✓ Two bathrooms
- ✓ Full kitchen and laundry
- ✓ Sitting space so companions are not confined to bedrooms
- ✓ New Cairo · Sheikh Zayed · Maadi · Downtown
- ✓ Suited to bariatric and cosmetic recovery stays

Transport

### Sedan with Driver
Price on request
For a patient travelling alone or with one companion. Professional driver on every transfer, arranged through licensed Egyptian operators.
- ✓ Up to 4 passengers
- ✓ Airport reception and departure transfer
- ✓ All clinic and hospital transfers during your stay

# Physiotherapy in Egypt for Gulf Patients | Hayakkom
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/physiotherapy/
Language: en

> Physiotherapy and rehabilitation appointments with licensed Egyptian providers, plus accommodation and daily transfers. Hayakkom coordinates; providers treat.

Physiotherapy
Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation in Egypt for Gulf Patients
Appointments with licensed Egyptian physiotherapy and rehabilitation providers, with your stay and transfers arranged around the sessions.

## How it works
You send us the referral or reports from your own doctor. We put them to a licensed physiotherapy provider, who confirms whether they can see you and proposes the number of sessions and a schedule. Hayakkom does not assess your condition or choose your treatment — the provider and your own physician do.

## What we coordinate
- Appointments at licensed physiotherapy and rehabilitation centres
- Accommodation close to the centre
- Daily transfers to and from your sessions
- Arabic-speaking coordination throughout your stay
- Contact with your treating surgeon or physician where you ask us to share reports
- A written schedule and cost estimate from the provider before you travel

## Who it is for
Patients whose own doctor has advised physiotherapy or rehabilitation — for example after an operation, after an injury, or for a long-term condition — and who prefer to have it in Egypt, often combined with a family trip. Whether physiotherapy is right for you is a decision for your doctor.

## Planning your stay
The number of sessions and the length of the programme are set by the provider, not by us. We plan accommodation by the week so it can be extended or shortened, and we leave room for rest days and, where the provider agrees, for sightseeing with your family.

## An important boundary
Physiotherapy is delivered by independent licensed Egyptian providers. Hayakkom is a coordination company: we do not diagnose, treat or advise on treatment, and we do not guarantee results. Prices are confirmed in writing by the provider before you book.

# العلاج في مصر من الدمام والخبر | حياكم
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/saudi-arabia/dammam/
Language: en

> من مطار الملك فهد الدولي إلى القاهرة للعلاج. إرشادات لمرضى الدمام والخبر والظهران والمنطقة الشرقية، مع نطاقات تكلفة بالريال وتنسيق بالعربية.

مسافر من الدمام والخبر
العلاج في مصر من الدمام والخبر
المرضى من الخبر والظهران وعموم المنطقة الشرقية يسافرون عادةً من مطار الملك فهد الدولي. ولأن تكرار الرحلات المباشرة أقل، نضيف يوم هامش إلى البرنامج بدلاً من افتراض ربط في نفس اليوم. زراعة الشعر وطب الأسنان وجراحات التخسيس والتجميل مع مزوّدين مصريين مرخّصين — بتنسيق كامل بالعربية، من أول رسالة حتى متابعتك بعد عودتك للمملكة.

لماذا مصر

## لماذا يسافر المرضى السعوديون إلى مصر للعلاج
01

### رحلة قصيرة لا سفر طويل
القاهرة على بُعد 2 إلى 3 ساعات من المدن السعودية الكبرى، برحلات مباشرة يومية. وهذا أهم مما يبدو: رحلة قصيرة للمرافق، ورحلة ثانية واقعية للعلاج الذي يحتاج مرحلتين، وعودة ميسّرة إن احتجت مراجعة إضافية.

02

### لا حاجز لغة في أي مرحلة
يُتعامل معك بالعربية من البداية للنهاية — الاستفسار الأول، وسجلاتك، وشرح العلاج، وأوراق المستشفى، والمتابعة. وفي القرار الطبي، فهمُ ما يُقترح عليك بدقة أهم من أي شيء آخر تقريباً.

03

### فرق تكلفة حقيقي في العلاج الخاص
العلاج الخاص في مصر أقل تكلفة بشكل ملحوظ من الرعاية الخاصة المماثلة في المملكة، خاصةً في طب الأسنان الاختياري وزراعة الشعر وجراحات التجميل. وننشر نطاقات سوقية موثّقة بالمصادر لا وعوداً، لتحكم بنفسك قبل السفر.

04

### قدرة راسخة على خدمة المرضى الدوليين
المستشفيات والعيادات التي ننسّق معها تعالج مرضى خليجيين بشكل معتاد وتفهم ما يعنيه ذلك — الجدولة حول السفر، ومرافقة العائلة للمريض، ومستندات يمكنك حملها إلى طبيبك في بلدك.

05

### مكان يناسب عائلتك فعلاً
المرافقون معك ليسوا محصورين في صالة انتظار. وعندما يسمح تعافيك، وبموافقة طبيبك فقط، هناك مجال لعائلتك أن ترى شيئاً من مصر أثناء راحتك.

الوصول

## الخطوط من المدن السعودية إلى القاهرة
أزمنة الطيران هي المدد المجدولة المعتادة. تأكّد دائماً من المواعيد الحالية وشروط الدخول مع شركة الطيران والجهات المختصة قبل الحجز — فهذه تتغيّر، ونفضّل أن تتحقق بنفسك لا أن تعتمد على صفحة إلكترونية.
الدمام والخبر
المطارمطار الملك فهد الدولي (DMM)
الرحلةمباشر إلى مطار القاهرة الدولي (CAI)، نحو 3 ساعات؛ والربط عبر الرياض أو جدة شائع أيضاً
الناقلاتالرحلات المباشرة أقل تكراراً من الرياض أو جدة، لذا يجب التحقق من المواعيد مبكراً
المرضى من الخبر والظهران وعموم المنطقة الشرقية يسافرون عادةً من مطار الملك فهد الدولي. ولأن تكرار الرحلات المباشرة أقل، نضيف يوم هامش إلى البرنامج بدلاً من افتراض ربط في نفس اليوم.

مدن سعودية أخرى
الرياض →جدة →كل السعودية →

العلاجات

## ما يأتي من أجله المرضى السعوديون غالباً
الأسعار أدناه نطاقات سوقية مصرية منشورة معروضة بالريال السعودي للسياق. وليست عرض سعر من حياكم. تكلفتك الخاصة يثبّتها المزوّد المعالج بعد التقييم السريري.
زراعة الشعر →الأسنان →جراحات التخسيس →جراحات التجميل →
تكاليف تقديرية

### ما يمكن أن تتوقعه

زراعة الشعر (FUE / DHI)
للجلسة

النطاق السائد في مصر
4,500 SAR – 11,300 SAR
النطاق الكامل المرصود: 3,800 SAR – 31,900 SAR
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: ٤–٦ أيام

يتحدد السعر أساساً بعدد البُصيلات والتقنية المستخدمة. FUT الأقل، FUE متوسط، DHI أعلى، والروبوت (ARTAS) الأعلى.

زراعة الأسنان
للسنّ الواحدة

النطاق السائد في مصر
940 SAR – 2,300 SAR
النطاق الكامل المرصود: 560 SAR – 3,300 SAR
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: زيارتان، ٣–٥ أيام لكل زيارة

ماركة الغرسة هي العامل الأكبر في السعر — الأنظمة الكورية الأقل، والسويسرية (Straumann) الأعلى. التاج غالباً يُحسب بشكل منفصل.

قشرة البورسلين
للسنّ الواحدة

النطاق السائد في مصر
340 SAR – 680 SAR
النطاق الكامل المرصود: 230 SAR – 1,100 SAR
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: ٥–٧ أيام

القشرة المركّبة أقل سعراً من البورسلين لكن عمرها أقصر. سعر السنّ الواحدة ينخفض عادةً في الطقم الكامل.

ابتسامة هوليوود (طقم كامل)
طقم كامل، ١٦–٢٠ سناً

النطاق السائد في مصر
6,800 SAR – 12,000 SAR
النطاق الكامل المرصود: 3,800 SAR – 15,000 SAR
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: ٧–١٠ أيام

يغطي عادةً جميع الأسنان الظاهرة. العدد النهائي يحدده طبيب الأسنان المعالج بعد الفحص.

زراعة الفك الكامل All-on-4
للفك الواحد

النطاق السائد في مصر
8,300 SAR – 11,300 SAR
النطاق الكامل المرصود: 5,900 SAR – 16,600 SAR
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: ٧–١٠ أيام

خيارات التحميل الفوري تتيح جسراً مؤقتاً في نفس اليوم. التركيبة النهائية تُثبَّت بعد الشفاء.

مدة الإقامة المقترحة: ٧–١٠ أيام

تُقيَّم الأهلية وفق مؤشر كتلة الجسم والحالات المصاحبة. تتطلب فحوصات قبل العملية ومتابعة غذائية.

غالباً يُدمج مع شفط الدهون. مطلوب عادةً بعد فقدان وزن كبير أو بعد الحمل.

تجميل الصدر (تكبير / تصغير / شد)
الإجراء

التكلفة
بعد التقييم السريري
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: ٨–١٢ يوماً

تقنيات الحشوات ونقل الدهون تختلف في السعر. تُقيَّم الملاءمة سريرياً.

تقديري — وليس سعراً نهائياً
الأرقام أعلاه بيانات سوقية عامة منشورة من عيادات ومنصات مصرية، وليست عرض سعر من حياكم. تختلف الأسعار اختلافاً كبيراً حسب التقنية والمواد وخبرة الطبيب. سعرك الفعلي يُحدَّد بعد المراجعة السريرية.
القرارات الطبية النهائية، بما فيها مدى ملاءمة أي إجراء لك، تعود للطبيب المعالج المرخّص. حياكم تنسّق ولا تقدّم خدمات طبية ولا تضمن نتائج.

احصل على تقدير التكلفةتحدّث مع منسّق
مصدر الأرقام: نطاقات مُجمَّعة من قوائم أسعار منشورة لعيادات ومستشفيات مصرية ومن منصات تجميع عروض العيادات، مراجَعة في 2026-09-15. هذه بيانات سوقية لأطراف ثالثة وليست عرض سعر من حياكم.محدَّث في 2026-09-15

الرحلة

## قبل السفر · وأنت في مصر · بعد عودتك
01

### قبل السفر
✓أرسل سجلاتك عبر واتساب أو البريد — التقارير والأشعة والمقطعية أو الرنين وأشعة الأسنان وتحاليل الدم والصور إن كانت ذات صلة سريرية
✓يراجع مزوّد مرخّص مناسب حالتك قبل أن تلتزم بتذاكر الطيران
✓تحصل على مسار مبدئي ومدة إقامة موصى بها وتقدير تكلفة تقديري
✓نخبرك بالفحوصات التي يمكن إكمالها في المملكة أولاً، وهذا يقصّر الرحلة غالباً
✓وإن لم تكن مرشّحاً مناسباً، تعرف ذلك قبل أن تنفق شيئاً على السفر

02

### وأنت في مصر
✓استقبال في مطار القاهرة الدولي
✓إقامة مختارة لتعافيك لا لعدد النجوم فقط — مصعد، غرف هادئة، خدمة غرف
✓مواعيد مرتّبة ضمن فترة سفرك
✓مرافقة بالعربية للاستشارات وللمستشفى
✓منسّق واحد يتولى التغييرات، لأن الجداول الطبية تتحرك
✓ترتيبات المرافقين والعائلة بجانب الخطة الطبية

03

### بعد عودتك للسعودية
✓ملخّص مكتوب لما أُجري، وقائمة أدويتك، وتعليمات العناية
✓جدول متابعة يُتفق عليه قبل مغادرتك مصر
✓تنسيق مع المزوّد المعالج إن ظهر سؤال بعد عودتك
✓المساعدة في ترتيب مراجعة إضافية، أو رحلة ثانية حيث يحتاجها العلاج

منسّقك
شخص واحد يتولى حالتك
يُخصَّص لك منسّق واحد يحمل ملفك بالكامل — السجلات والتواصل مع المزوّد والمواعيد والإقامة والتنقلات والمتابعة. وسيكون لديك رقم واتسابه المباشر. لن تُحوَّل بين مركز اتصال وفريق مبيعات، ولن تُعيد شرح حالتك في كل مرة تتواصل.

راسل منسّقاً على واتساب

ملاحظات عملية

## أمور تستحق المعرفة قبل قدومك

### فرق التوقيت
السعودية عادةً تسبق مصر بساعة. وخلال التوقيت الصيفي المصري يتساوى التوقيتان. يجدر التحقق عند الاتفاق على مواعيد معنا.

### العملة
الجنيه المصري معوّم فتتحرك أسعاره. والريال السعودي مربوط بالدولار الأمريكي. لذلك نعرض أرقاماً تقديرية بالريال أو الدولار لا بالجنيه، الذي يتقادم سريعاً.

### أين ستُعالَج
في القاهرة والجيزة غالباً، حيث مستشفياتنا وعياداتنا الشريكة. ويمكن ترتيب إقامات التعافي والعافية على البحر الأحمر أو غيره بعد تصريح طبيبك بالسفر داخلياً.

### الهاتف والتواصل
لدينا رقم سعودي حتى لا تُجري مكالمة دولية لتسأل سؤالاً، وواتساب هو القناة التي يستخدمها معظم المرضى فعلاً.

أسئلة المرضى السعوديين

## أكثر ما يُسأل من المملكة

### هل يمكن تقييم حالتي قبل السفر؟
نعم، وينبغي ذلك. أرسل سجلاتك فيراجعها مزوّد مرخّص مناسب قبل حجز الطيران. فتعرف المسار العلاجي المحتمل ومدة الإقامة والتكلفة التقديرية — والأهم، هل أنت مرشّح أصلاً. والسفر أولاً ثم السؤال هو الطريق إلى إهدار المال.

### كم سأحتاج أن أغيب عن بلدي؟
يعتمد كلياً على الإجراء. زراعة الشعر 4 إلى 6 أيام. قشرة الأسنان 5 إلى 7 أيام. زراعة الأسنان عادةً رحلتان من 3 إلى 5 أيام بفارق أشهر. جراحة السمنة 7 إلى 10 أيام. جراحة التجميل 7 إلى 14 يوماً، لأن جرّاحك يجب أن يصرّح بلياقتك للسفر قبل أن تسافر.

### هل سيكون كل شيء بالعربية؟
نعم. التنسيق ومستنداتك والمرافقة في المواعيد والمتابعة كلها بالعربية. والإنجليزية متاحة إن كنت تفضّلها.

### هل يمكن أن تأتي زوجتي وأطفالي معي؟
نعم، ومعظم المرضى يأتون بعائلاتهم. نرتّب إقامة تناسب عائلة لا مسافراً منفرداً، ونقلاً، وأنشطة للمرافقين تتوافق مع جدول علاجك.

### هل يمكنني رؤية الأسعار بالريال السعودي؟
نعم. كل نطاق سعري على الموقع يمكن تحويله إلى الريال السعودي، والريال مربوط بالدولار الأمريكي، فهذه التحويلات مستقرة لا تتغيّر يومياً.

### من يُجري علاجي فعلاً؟
طبيب أو جرّاح مصري مرخّص ومستقل في مرفق مرخّص. تنسّق حياكم الوصول والمواعيد واللوجستيات. نحن لسنا مستشفى ولا عيادة، ولا نشخّص ولا نعالج، ولا نضمن نتائج طبية.

### ماذا لو احتاج العلاج وقتاً أطول من المخطط؟
منسّقك يتولى ذلك — إعادة جدولة المواعيد، وتمديد الإقامة، والمساعدة في تغيير تذكرتك. وهذا من أكثر الأسباب التي تجعل الناس يفضّلون التنسيق على ترتيب كل شيء بأنفسهم من بلد آخر.

### ماذا يحدث بعد عودتي للسعودية؟
تغادر مصر بملخّص علاج مكتوب وأدويتك وجدول متابعة متفق عليه. وإن استجدّ أمر في بلدك، ننسّق مع المزوّد المعالج، ونساعد في ترتيب مراجعة إضافية أو رحلة ثانية حيث يتطلب العلاج ذلك.

### ماذا أحمل معي؟
سجلاتك الطبية وأي تصوير، وقائمة أدويتك الحالية بجرعاتها، وبيانات تأمينك إن كانت ذات صلة، وملابس مريحة واسعة إن كنت ستُجري جراحة. ونرسل لك قائمة محددة بعد تثبيت مسارك، لأنها تختلف بحسب الإجراء.

### وماذا عن شروط الدخول؟
شروط الدخول تتغيّر، ولن نذكرها على صفحة إلكترونية كأنها ثابتة. تأكّد من الشروط الحالية مع الجهات المصرية أو شركة طيرانك قبل الحجز، وسنرشدك إلى المستندات التي يتطلبها علاجك نفسه.

## من ننسّق معهم

↔ اسحب لتحريك الشعارات
تُقدَّم الخدمات الطبية من قِبَل هذه الجهات المرخّصة والمستقلة. حياكم تنسّق الوصول والمواعيد ولا تقدّم العلاج بنفسها.

أرسل حالتك الطبية

## ابدأ بسجلاتك لا بحجز
أرسل ما لديك وسنعود إليك بمسار ومدة إقامة مقترحة وتقدير — قبل أن تنفق شيئاً على الطيران.
📱 راسل منسّقاً على واتسابنموذج التواصل

جارٍ تحميل النموذج…

تنسّق حياكم الوصول إلى مزوّدي رعاية صحية مصريين مرخّصين ومستقلين، وهم المسؤولون عن الرعاية السريرية التي يقدّمونها. حياكم ليست مستشفى ولا عيادة ولا طبيباً، ولا تشخّص ولا تعالج، ولا تمارس نشاط التأمين أو الوساطة، ولا تضمن نتائج طبية. تُنفَّذ خدمات السفر عبر مشغّلين مصريين مرخّصين. ونطاقات الأسعار المعروضة بيانات سوقية منشورة لأطراف ثالثة، وليست عرض سعر من حياكم.

حياكم لحلول الرعاية الصحية والخدمات اللوجستية — شركة مصرية (شخص واحد محدودة المسؤولية) مسجّلة وفق القانون رقم 159 لسنة 1981. نقدّم الاستشارات الإدارية والتسويقية للخدمات الطبية، وتنسيق المواعيد والحجوزات لدى المستشفيات والمراكز الطبية، وتنظيم المؤتمرات والفعاليات الطبية، والخدمات اللوجستية لمسافري الخليج.
حياكم ليست مستشفى أو عيادة أو مقدّم خدمة طبية، ولا تمارس نشاط التأمين أو الوساطة. جميع خدمات العلاج الطبي وطب الأسنان تُقدَّم من قِبَل مزوّدي رعاية صحية مصريين مرخّصين ومستقلين. تُنفَّذ ترتيبات السفر والجولات والنقل عبر مشغّلين سياحيين مصريين مرخّصين. حياكم لا تضمن نتائج طبية.

# العلاج في مصر للسعوديين: الأسعار والمدة ٢٠٢٦ | حياكم
URL: https://www.hayakkom.com/saudi-arabia/
Language: en

> دليل المريض السعودي للعلاج في مصر: الأسعار بالريال، ومدة الإقامة لكل علاج، ومدة الطيران من الرياض وجدة والدمام

السعودية
العلاج الطبي في مصر للمرضى القادمين من السعودية
زراعة الشعر وطب الأسنان وجراحات التخسيس والتجميل مع مزوّدين مصريين مرخّصين — بتنسيق كامل بالعربية، من أول رسالة حتى متابعتك بعد عودتك للمملكة.

لماذا مصر

## لماذا يسافر المرضى السعوديون إلى مصر للعلاج
01

### رحلة قصيرة لا سفر طويل
القاهرة على بُعد 2 إلى 3 ساعات من المدن السعودية الكبرى، برحلات مباشرة يومية. وهذا أهم مما يبدو: رحلة قصيرة للمرافق، ورحلة ثانية واقعية للعلاج الذي يحتاج مرحلتين، وعودة ميسّرة إن احتجت مراجعة إضافية.

02

### لا حاجز لغة في أي مرحلة
يُتعامل معك بالعربية من البداية للنهاية — الاستفسار الأول، وسجلاتك، وشرح العلاج، وأوراق المستشفى، والمتابعة. وفي القرار الطبي، فهمُ ما يُقترح عليك بدقة أهم من أي شيء آخر تقريباً.

03

### فرق تكلفة حقيقي في العلاج الخاص
العلاج الخاص في مصر أقل تكلفة بشكل ملحوظ من الرعاية الخاصة المماثلة في المملكة، خاصةً في طب الأسنان الاختياري وزراعة الشعر وجراحات التجميل. وننشر نطاقات سوقية موثّقة بالمصادر لا وعوداً، لتحكم بنفسك قبل السفر.

04

### قدرة راسخة على خدمة المرضى الدوليين
المستشفيات والعيادات التي ننسّق معها تعالج مرضى خليجيين بشكل معتاد وتفهم ما يعنيه ذلك — الجدولة حول السفر، ومرافقة العائلة للمريض، ومستندات يمكنك حملها إلى طبيبك في بلدك.

05

### مكان يناسب عائلتك فعلاً
المرافقون معك ليسوا محصورين في صالة انتظار. وعندما يسمح تعافيك، وبموافقة طبيبك فقط، هناك مجال لعائلتك أن ترى شيئاً من مصر أثناء راحتك.

الوصول

## الخطوط من المدن السعودية إلى القاهرة
أزمنة الطيران هي المدد المجدولة المعتادة. تأكّد دائماً من المواعيد الحالية وشروط الدخول مع شركة الطيران والجهات المختصة قبل الحجز — فهذه تتغيّر، ونفضّل أن تتحقق بنفسك لا أن تعتمد على صفحة إلكترونية.
الرياض
المطارمطار الملك خالد الدولي (RUH)
الرحلةمباشر إلى مطار القاهرة الدولي (CAI)، نحو ساعتين و45 دقيقة إلى 3 ساعات
الناقلاتتُشغّل السعودية ومصر للطيران الخط يومياً، بعدة رحلات في معظم الأيام
أكبر عدد من المرضى السعوديين الذين ننسّق لهم يسافرون من الرياض. رحلات الصباح تصل القاهرة ويتبقّى من اليوم ما يكفي لاستشارة بعد الظهر، وهذا قد يوفّر عليك ليلة.
صفحة الرياض →
جدة
المطارمطار الملك عبدالعزيز الدولي (JED)
الرحلةمباشر إلى مطار القاهرة الدولي (CAI)، نحو ساعتين و15 دقيقة — أقصر رحلة من السعودية
الناقلاتتخدم الخط السعودية ومصر للطيران وشركات اقتصادية، وهو عادةً الأكثر تكراراً بين السعودية ومصر
لجدة أقصر رحلة وأكثر المواعيد، ما يجعلها الأسهل للعلاج الذي يحتاج رحلتين منفصلتين — وخاصةً زراعة الأسنان، حيث يفصل بين وضع الغرسة وتركيب التاج أشهر.
صفحة جدة →
الدمام والخبر
المطارمطار الملك فهد الدولي (DMM)
الرحلةمباشر إلى مطار القاهرة الدولي (CAI)، نحو 3 ساعات؛ والربط عبر الرياض أو جدة شائع أيضاً
الناقلاتالرحلات المباشرة أقل تكراراً من الرياض أو جدة، لذا يجب التحقق من المواعيد مبكراً
المرضى من الخبر والظهران وعموم المنطقة الشرقية يسافرون عادةً من مطار الملك فهد الدولي. ولأن تكرار الرحلات المباشرة أقل، نضيف يوم هامش إلى البرنامج بدلاً من افتراض ربط في نفس اليوم.
صفحة الدمام والخبر →

العلاجات

## ما يأتي من أجله المرضى السعوديون غالباً
الأسعار أدناه نطاقات سوقية مصرية منشورة معروضة بالريال السعودي للسياق. وليست عرض سعر من حياكم. تكلفتك الخاصة يثبّتها المزوّد المعالج بعد التقييم السريري.
زراعة الشعر →الأسنان →جراحات التخسيس →جراحات التجميل →
تكاليف تقديرية

### ما يمكن أن تتوقعه

زراعة الشعر (FUE / DHI)
للجلسة

النطاق السائد في مصر
4,500 SAR – 11,300 SAR
النطاق الكامل المرصود: 3,800 SAR – 31,900 SAR
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: ٤–٦ أيام

يتحدد السعر أساساً بعدد البُصيلات والتقنية المستخدمة. FUT الأقل، FUE متوسط، DHI أعلى، والروبوت (ARTAS) الأعلى.

زراعة الأسنان
للسنّ الواحدة

النطاق السائد في مصر
940 SAR – 2,300 SAR
النطاق الكامل المرصود: 560 SAR – 3,300 SAR
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: زيارتان، ٣–٥ أيام لكل زيارة

ماركة الغرسة هي العامل الأكبر في السعر — الأنظمة الكورية الأقل، والسويسرية (Straumann) الأعلى. التاج غالباً يُحسب بشكل منفصل.

قشرة البورسلين
للسنّ الواحدة

النطاق السائد في مصر
340 SAR – 680 SAR
النطاق الكامل المرصود: 230 SAR – 1,100 SAR
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: ٥–٧ أيام

القشرة المركّبة أقل سعراً من البورسلين لكن عمرها أقصر. سعر السنّ الواحدة ينخفض عادةً في الطقم الكامل.

ابتسامة هوليوود (طقم كامل)
طقم كامل، ١٦–٢٠ سناً

النطاق السائد في مصر
6,800 SAR – 12,000 SAR
النطاق الكامل المرصود: 3,800 SAR – 15,000 SAR
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: ٧–١٠ أيام

يغطي عادةً جميع الأسنان الظاهرة. العدد النهائي يحدده طبيب الأسنان المعالج بعد الفحص.

زراعة الفك الكامل All-on-4
للفك الواحد

النطاق السائد في مصر
8,300 SAR – 11,300 SAR
النطاق الكامل المرصود: 5,900 SAR – 16,600 SAR
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: ٧–١٠ أيام

خيارات التحميل الفوري تتيح جسراً مؤقتاً في نفس اليوم. التركيبة النهائية تُثبَّت بعد الشفاء.

10,100 SAR – 16,900 SAR
النطاق الكامل المرصود: 5,600 SAR – 23,600 SAR
مدة الإقامة المقترحة: ٧–١٠ أيام

تُقيَّم الأهلية وفق مؤشر كتلة الجسم والحالات المصاحبة. تتطلب فحوصات قبل العملية ومتابعة غذائية.

الاختيار بين التكميم والتحويل قرار سريري يتخذه جرّاح السمنة، وليس قراراً سعرياً.

تزيد التكلفة بعدد المناطق والتقنية. تقنيات الفيزر (VASER) والليزر أعلى سعراً من الشفط التقليدي.

إعادة تجميل الأنف أعلى تكلفة من العملية الأولى. يمكن دمج تعديل الحاجز الأنفي لتحسين التنفس.
